## Summary
- The system prompt now maps what an answer contains (lists of attributes, warnings, statuses, measured values, long detail) to the json-render display components that show it best, instead of defaulting to a table.
- Documents in the README how json-render is used end to end: prompt, stored spec, UI catalog validation, and the allow-list of read-only components.

## Test plan
- [ ] API: `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q`
- [ ] UI: `yarn lint && yarn format:check && yarn tsc --noEmit && yarn test`
